partnerPage.metaTitle: Partner with Kadaima: Empowering Educators Across Sri Lanka
partnerPage.metaDescription: Work with Kadaima to reach students nationwide, share your expertise, and generate a steady extra income. Open to teachers, tutors, language instructors, and institutes.
partnerPage.heroSubtitle: Work with Kadaima to reach students nationwide, share your expertise, and generate a steady extra income.
partnerPage.heroImageAlt: A professional teacher using a laptop for digital education
partnerPage.audienceIntro: Our platform is fully open to all educators who wish to make a difference:
partnerPage.audienceSchoolDesc: For Scholarship, O/L, A/L, and general subjects.
partnerPage.audienceLanguageDesc: Specifically for IELTS, Japanese, Korean (EPS-TOPIK), and other language proficiency exams.
partnerPage.audienceCompetitiveDesc: Instructors guiding students for specialized local and international competitive exams.
partnerPage.audienceInstituteDesc: Organizations looking for co-branded exams, events, or institutional licenses to offer structured online practice.
partnerPage.featuresTitle: What you can do as a Partner
partnerPage.featureQuizzesDesc: Easily build MCQ quizzes, timed exams, and comprehensive past papers.
partnerPage.featureProfileDesc: Build your brand with a dedicated teacher profile and a shared quiz library.
partnerPage.featureMaterialsDesc: Upload full learning modules and tutorials. Students can read your materials and immediately take a customized quiz based on that module.
partnerPage.dashboardImageAlt: Teacher dashboard showing quiz creation and earning statistics
partnerPage.earnIntro: Revenue on our platform is shared through a fair and transparent model. 60% of all student subscription fees go into the Teacher Revenue Pool, and the remaining 40% covers platform maintenance and technology (Kadaima Commission).
partnerPage.earnPoolDesc: When subscribed students attempt your quizzes, you earn a fair share of the teacher pool.
partnerPage.earnPayoutDesc: Your share grows with unique student attempts. More practice on your quizzes means a larger monthly payout.
partnerPage.earnStep1Desc: Student fees create the monthly revenue. 60% goes to teachers.
partnerPage.earnStep2Desc: Unique attempts on your quizzes determine your share.
partnerPage.earnStep3Desc: Your payout = (your unique attempts ÷ total attempts) × 60% pool.

partnerPage.elevateIntro: Kadaima LMS helps you deliver structured online training, grow your student reach, and maximise income from the value you create.
partnerPage.elevateCustomNote: Need a unique, customised system for your institute or class? Kadaima LMS is ready for that too.
partnerPage.elevateItem1Desc: Easily control everything in your class or institute from one place.
partnerPage.elevateItem2Desc: Fast, secure, and easy-to-use modern digital technology.
partnerPage.elevateItem3Desc: Maximum digital value for your institute at a fair, affordable cost.
partnerPage.elevateFeature1Desc: Only students who have paid class fees can download tutes. Unpaid students are automatically blocked from downloads.
partnerPage.elevateFeature2Desc: Only payment-verified students can watch your private YouTube sessions and recorded lessons.

partnerPage.elevateFeature5Desc: Record and monitor student attendance accurately.
partnerPage.elevateFeature6Desc: Cut unnecessary printing and maintenance costs, control institute expenses, and grow revenue.
